First public release of **JD Highlighter** — a borderless, freely-accented dark theme for
JDownloader 2. Minimalist IBM Carbon (`#161616`) monochrome with subtly rounded corners and a
single user-chosen accent that lights up the controls; large fills stay neutral so text stays
readable at any hue. Works on the desktop app and the Docker container.

## Added

- **Two-file theme.** `theme/cfg/laf/FlatDarkLaf.json` — the Carbon `colorfor*` palette for JD's
  content areas (download list, link grabber, settings table, scrollbars), selection kept neutral
  at `#525252`. `theme/flatlaf/FlatDarkLaf.properties.tmpl` — the FlatLaf control theme:
  borderless colours, fill-based text fields (`#1e1e1e`, no frame), rounded corners
  (buttons/fields ~6px, checkbox ~4px) and the `@accentColor` cascade.
- **Free accent, safe at any hue.** One value you pick (any hex, default `#ffee00`) tints
  checkmarks, radios, toggle-on, focus rings, links, the download progress bar and primary
  buttons. The accent-button foreground is **auto-contrasted** (dark text on a light accent, light
  text on a dark one). Large text-bearing fills are never washed in accent.
- **Desktop delivery.** A tiny theme agent (`jd-highlighter-agent.jar`, compiled `--release 21`)
  registers the FlatLaf custom-defaults source from `premain`; installers for all platforms wire it
  via one idempotent `-javaagent:` line in JDownloader's install4j `.vmoptions`:
  - `install/install.sh` (Linux/macOS) and `install/install.ps1` + `install/install.bat` (Windows)
    — copy the theme, select `FLATLAF_DARK`, render the accented control theme, install the agent
    and wire it. Accent is a CLI argument / `-Accent` parameter (default `#ffee00`).
  - `install/uninstall.sh` and `install/uninstall.ps1` — remove exactly the agent line and the
    `.jd-highlighter` directory.
- **Container delivery.** `JD_THEME=jd-highlighter` selects the theme in the
  JDownloader-for-Unraid container; `JD_ACCENT=#rrggbb` sets the accent (default `#ffee00`). Both
  are re-applied on every start.
- **Shared accent helper** (`lib/accent.sh`) — POSIX luminance/contrast + template render, with a
  unit test (`test/test-accent.sh`).
- Integration test (`test/test-install.sh`), CI (JSON lint, ShellCheck, agent compile with a
  class-version 65 assertion, installer + accent tests) and a README covering the borderless/accent
  design plus desktop and container install, accent changes and uninstall.

## How to use

Download `jd-highlighter-v1.0.0.zip`, unzip, and run the installer for your OS (pass any hex as the
accent), then restart JDownloader. In the container, set `JD_THEME=jd-highlighter` and optionally
`JD_ACCENT`. See the README for changing the accent and uninstalling.

## Credits

The two-path technique is derived from the dark theme in the JDownloader-for-Unraid container; the
colours (IBM Carbon monochrome) and accent handling are our own. Sibling to jd-plain-dark. MIT.
